_comment: NFC / QR tag registry. Key = the code physically written to the tag (or the tag's own 7-byte UID in hex, no colons). Value.record = which record that tag opens; several tags can point at the same record and a tag can be re-pointed without touching the physical object. Nothing secret lives here: it ships to the browser so a tap resolves without a round trip.
